independent_second_source.public_observation: env.reset or env.step observation uint8 64x64x3, no info fields

source_original_actions: Source native env.reset and env.step without staged or simulated world state.
action_policy: Uniform Random seeded int(1000003*seed+337+10007*stream), source-independent no world truth, action from public action-space size only, no reward or info used
native_episode_digest: SHA256 over chronological source identifier, reset seed, stream, public observation before and after actual original step, and chosen original action
public_stimuli: Only source observations and available action index. No environment source-private state, world location, goal, reward, mission or info.
source_differences: This is source admission, not equality of observation or action spaces, sampled history features, or learner inputs.
source_creation_and_custody: Exact upstream Git checkouts, clean worktrees, one native worker per independent environment, unaltered original source engines.
primary_evidence: Genuine count of source-native public action/next-observation transitions, deterministic cross-OS episode hash receipt, independent source provenance and public-only actor, no fabricated transitions.
admissibility_pass: Both upstream exact original SHA pins verified and all 16 episodes contain >=1 native source step, authentic unchanged public observation shape/dtype, repeatable Windows/Linux digest, zero private world inputs to policy. Stop if a source cannot run unchanged.
target_future_experiment: After dual original native admission, freeze prospective public-history vs current-observation conventional learner training and independent preregistered evaluation; no claim of history sufficiency from source admission.
resource_receipt: Actor+environment+source trace process CPU, OS peak RSS, serialized digest and source byte counts separately by source, with no interfamily efficiency claims.
g29_original_atlas: BLOCKED until exact reviewed source-bound artifact repair and final regressions
